about: What scripts/project-sync.js mirrors into the Project tracker, besides the proposed requirements and Spec Kit tasks (read from every specs/<nnn>/ except the shared 001) and the agents' queued jobs (learn_jobs). 'people' are the shared spec's checks only a person can do; scripts/spec-status.js reads the same list.

milestone.name: Research layer (proposed)
milestone.description: Work described in specs/002-research-layer/spec.md. Needs both partners' approval before it counts.

people.REQ-019: Live at a public URL, shared with the class 2 weeks before the presentation: a deployment fact (merge, deploy, share the link).
people.SC-001: A classmate signs up and sees the feed in under 2 minutes: time it with a real classmate on the live site.
people.SC-008: Each partner's build has a passing test for every requirement: this build does (every testable REQ above); run the same suite against Matt's build.
people.SC-004: 9 of every 10 stories in a live sample of 20 judged on-topic by both partners: do it on the live feed.
people.REQ-020: Each partner keeps a human-written agent log in AGENT_LOG.md: the file exists (the automated check), but it has no entries yet. Only Matt and John can write them; agents must not.

scheduled.title: Daily paper watch and paper-to-code (scheduled agent task)
scheduled.description: Every day at 5:47 AM Central a scheduled agent task finds new papers, runs scripts/watch.js, builds at most one paper-to-code toy and pushes it to a feature/paper-watch-<date> branch (never main). Review those branches; nothing merges on its own. The GitHub Actions workflow .github/workflows/paper-watch.yml runs the watcher with direct arXiv access once it is merged.

scheduled.title: Daily agent check-in (scheduled agent task)
scheduled.description: After the paper watch, the same scheduled task runs scripts/checkin.js: requirements waiting for both partners' approval, people checks, forecasts that have fallen due, reviews waiting for a person, queued agent jobs and paper-watch branches nobody has reviewed. It reports what is stuck and the next action for each, and moves agent jobs along; it never approves a requirement, merges or deploys.
